item.title: How Zheng Shuang Went From Star To Outcast
item.description: Zheng Shuang was once one of China’s biggest young actresses, but her career collapsed in 2021 after a surrogacy controversy and accusations involving her children. Months later, authorities fined her 299 million yuan for tax evasion and banned her from broadcast productions.

item.title: Her Disappearance Led Police To The Gilgo Beach Killer
item.description: Shannan Gilbert vanished from Oak Beach in 2010 after fleeing a client’s home and calling 911 for help. Her disappearance led investigators to discover multiple sets of remains along Gilgo Beach. Gilbert’s remains were found in 2011, but her cause of death remains undetermined.

item.title: The Warning Signs Police Missed At Fox Hollow Farm
item.description: Herb Baumeister was linked to the disappearances of numerous men before investigators searched his Indiana estate in 1996 and found thousands of human bone fragments. A detective had been investigating him for years, but repeated attempts to search the property were unsuccessful.

item.title: The Family Vlogger Whose Secret Abuse Was Exposed
item.description: Ruby Franke built a following by documenting family life on YouTube, but her public image collapsed after her 2023 arrest for aggravated child abuse. She pleaded guilty to four counts and was sentenced to four consecutive prison terms of one to 15 years.

item.title: Ted Bundy’s Final Words Were Not What People Expected
item.description: Before his 1989 execution, Ted Bundy gave a final interview in which he admitted killing women and discussed his crimes with psychologist James Dobson. In the death chamber, his last words were a message of love to his family and friends.

item.title: The Father Vanished After His Family Was Found Dead
item.description: In 2011, Agnès Dupont de Ligonnès and her four children were found dead beneath the terrace of their Nantes home. Xavier Dupont de Ligonnès, the main suspect, disappeared days later and has never been found, leaving one of France’s most notorious mysteries unresolved.

item.title: She Played A Killer While Awaiting Trial For Murder
item.description: Aisling Tucker Moore-Reed, who acted as Wyn Reed, was charged with killing her uncle in Oregon in 2016. While awaiting trial on bail, she landed the lead role in a horror film where her character shoots a man in self-defense. She later pleaded guilty to manslaughter.

item.title: Two Trials Failed To Answer Who Killed Jessica Chambers
item.description: Jessica Chambers died in 2014 after being attacked and set on fire in Mississippi. Quinton Tellis was tried twice for her murder, but both juries deadlocked. Prosecutors have since declined to pursue a third trial, leaving her killing officially unresolved.

item.title: She Was Secretly Cyberbullying Her Own Daughter
item.description: Kendra Licari spent more than a year sending anonymous, harassing messages to her teenage daughter and the girl’s boyfriend while pretending to be a classmate. Investigators eventually traced the messages back to Licari, who pleaded guilty to two counts of stalking a minor and was sentenced to prison.

item.title: His Confessions Revealed A Pattern Of Five Murders
item.description: Shawn Grate confessed to multiple killings after police arrested him in 2016. He was convicted of 23 charges, including two aggravated murders in Ashland County, and sentenced to death; he was later linked to three additional murders in Ohio.
